mentions.name: getalcor.com
mentions.description: One of a chain of apps that hand off content to one another where possible, using on-device AI. Part of the author's startup experiment, which they may wind down after burning tokens and building more than serving end users well.
mentions.source_excerpt: i've been building wearover and getalcor.com -- a chain of apps handing off content where possible with use of on-device AI , but burning tokens and building more than serving the product well to end users, and might just wind up my startup experiment and take up a job or contract.
mentions.author: anupamchugh
